chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 301 – The Lost Bloodline: Ji Ning’s Shocking Family Reunion
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning meets the Xiyue Commandery Princess, who reveals a truth that changes everything — she is his long-lost cousin and the last true heir of the Yuchi clan.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 301 – Family Hidden in the Shadows
og_description: A blood ritual seals a reunion between two orphans bound by the same enemy.
twitter_title: Ji Ning discovers his older cousin alive — and she’s a princess.
twitter_description: The Yuchi name lives on, and a blood feud is reborn.

lore_anchors.definition: Yuchi Xiyue, the true elder cousin of Ji Ning and the last descendant of the Yuchi clan; secretly bears a burning grudge against the Shaoyin clan.
A ritual using blood resonance to confirm shared ancestry; the golden filaments of blood will merge if a true blood relationship exists.
A demon born from the cultivator’s own inner demons, desires, and traumas; it is the most dangerous element of any tribulation, capable of causing madness or death.
Periodic life-or-death ordeals faced by cultivators below Celestial Immortal, testing both body and soul.
A former collateral member of the Grand Xia royal clan who rose to Celestial Immortal through heretical cultivation; grandfather of Yuchi Xiyue.
The ancient clan responsible for exterminating the Yuchi bloodline; the primary target of Ji Ning and his cousin’s revenge.
